evaluation.fitMonitorScope: Fixed original 256 fit games and separate added-fit 128 old plus 128 new games; diagnostic only.

limitations: Research controls were rejected, not promoted. No warm start from controls or full-corpus models.
The larger empirical training population changes natural class frequencies; importance coefficients describe that new population.
Class quotas and optimizer budget stay fixed, reducing exposure per window as data grows.
Added-fit monitor is trained for treatment but untrained for control and is diagnostic only.
Fresh internal holdout is original train and was seen by historical full-corpus models, which are not controls here.
Architecture screen retained as history; original full quality screen and per-model strict >75% target remain separate.
Only three-player pilot evidence; no four-player, formal acceptance or App deployment claim.

sampling.normalization: mean of per-window full CE times fixed population importance coefficient; no batch self normalization

target: Every applicable true action class has choice-only complete-candidate Top1 strictly >0.75 in one model; no across-checkpoint combination.
